steps.title: Clear the clutter
steps.say: Let me clear those small labels and tell this as a simple story instead.

steps.title: Same price, more buyers
steps.say: At the old price, buyers now want more than before. That is all a demand shift means.

ops.text:
same price,
more buyers
want it

steps.title: So there is a shortage
steps.say: Sellers still bring the same amount to market, so at that price some buyers go home empty-handed.

steps.title: Buyers bid the price up
steps.say: The buyers who missed out offer more, so the price climbs to a new equilibrium where demand and supply meet again.

steps.title: The story in words
steps.say: Same idea in plain words: more buyers, same number of bikes, so the price rises.

ops.text:
Simple story
$100: 3 people wanted
a bike. Now 6 want one.
Sellers still have only 3.
Some buyers miss out, so
they offer more money.
Price rises until only
3 people want it again.
